title: Defer Patterns & Cleanup
focus: defer, resource cleanup, panic recovery, named returns
rules: SafeDivide uses recover() to catch divide-by-zero panics
Pipeline ensures completed/failed is always recorded

flashcards.front: When does a deferred function execute?
flashcards.back: After the surrounding function returns (or panics). Deferred calls execute in LIFO order (last deferred, first executed).

flashcards.front: What is the most common use of defer?
flashcards.back: Resource cleanup: closing files, releasing locks, closing database connections. defer ensures cleanup happens even if the function panics.

flashcards.front: Can you recover from a panic in a deferred function?
flashcards.back: Yes. Call recover() inside a deferred function. If a panic is active, recover() returns the panic value. Otherwise it returns nil.

flashcards.front: What is a gotcha with defer and loops?
flashcards.back: defer executes when the FUNCTION returns, not the loop iteration. In a loop, defer will accumulate until the function exits. Extract the loop body into a helper function.
